feature_request_grid.phase_source: Frozen original app32 audit, learned from training only

live_freshness_definition: Serving cache receipt age and provider feed last_updated age must each be <=300s when present; this is a serving contract, not a claim that the five-minute validation collector implements a live cache
lag_policy: Latest valid snapshot <= request_time-lag; never nearest future; missing lags remain native NaN with flags
feature_metadata_policy: Capacity/coordinates/service metadata taken from the exact causal base snapshot, not future station-map intervals or 2026 metadata

label_policy.method: nearest valid strictly after request, ties earlier, same split, reject >50m relocation
label_policy.missing: exclude, never zero or arbitrary forward fill

label_task: Bike/dock unavailability; known closed target is unavailable; missing target excluded
base_policy: Known valid and In Service causal base; no label peeking in feature builder

B2.sparse_cell_fallback: Station overall rate from same fit period
B2.training_replay_fit: Only prior complete training weeks; first week has no B2 and requires B1 fallback

OD.fallback: 1.3 * haversine_distance_m / 4 m/s, as proposal; zero-distance self pairs retained and flagged

weather: Excluded: historical issue/publication provenance remains unresolved

split_roles.train: Forecaster fit and future policy training pool

policy_split: No fifth chronological policy partition; any policy training uses train-only out-of-fold forecaster predictions, not supplied by this feature audit
limits: Recorded source timestamps stand in for unmeasured historical publication latency
Prospective 2026 identity filter is external deployment scope, not test-label selection
Feature-table audit is not model or replay-policy performance validation
